note: うさひめ four-legged hop (same crouching body as ウサギン), facing RIGHT (native: 1); mirror horizontally for left. Lowest outline row 30 on contact frames 0 and 3; frames 1-2 airborne (body raised). Row 31 is empty.

frames.name: walk_0
frames.desc: crouch (contact): body squashed 1px, ready to hop; lowest outline row 30

frames.name: walk_1
frames.desc: push-off: body stretched 1px tall and lifted 1px (hind feet leaving the ground)

frames.name: walk_2
frames.desc: airborne: whole body 2px up (tiara and ears with it)

frames.name: walk_3
frames.desc: land (contact): back on the ground, squashed 1px; lowest outline row 30
